subject: general
question: Choose the correct meaning of idiom: **Cut the Gordian knot**

options.text: To solve a complex problem decisively

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **To solve a complex problem decisively**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Cut the Gordian knot"** means to solve a very complicated or intricate problem in a bold and decisive manner. (एक जटिल समस्या को निर्णायक और साहसिक तरीके से हल करना।) • **Example:** The CEO decided to cut the Gordian knot by restructuring the entire company to address its financial problems. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To tie up loose ends** (बाकी कामों को निपटाना): To finish small, unresolved tasks or details. • **Example:** Before we launch the project, we need to tie up all the loose ends. • **Option 2: To delay resolution** (समाधान में देरी करना): To postpone or procrastinate in addressing a problem. • **Example:** The committee decided to delay resolution on the controversial issue until the next meeting. • **Option 3: To create a new problem** (एक नई समस्या खड़ी करना): To cause additional complications or difficulties. • **Example:** By ignoring the root cause, they created a new problem that was even harder to solve. • **Option 5: (No explanation provided in question)**: This option is irrelevant to the idiom. 3e:Ta1b, The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. Feeling confused or perplexed.
